title: Why Top Practices Pull Ahead
summary: Join this free CE webinar on Dec 10 to learn how top dental practices boost retention, acceptance, and collections in 2027. Earn 1 CE credit.
body_markdown:
The gap between top-performing practices and everyone else is widening. Top practices retain patients at a 14% higher rate than average, convert treatment at 76% compared with an average of 45%, and collect 97% of what they produce compared with 80%. The question isn’t whether that gap exists, but what’s driving it.


Most practices only see their own numbers. This session draws on performance data from thousands of practice locations, survey responses from more than 2,500 dental professionals, and direct patient feedback to show why top practices are pulling ahead across three areas:


1. **Patients** : How clear communication, upfront cost, and flexible payment options drive retention and treatment acceptance
2. **Process** : Where AI and automation reduce administrative work and support clinical consistency, and where human judgment still matters most
3. **Profits** : How financial discipline, stronger collections, and a healthy team culture fuel sustainable growth


Attendees will leave with practical strategies to close the gap and build a practice that works better for them and their patients. This complimentary webinar is eligible for 1 hour of continuing education (CE) credit.


CE Learning Objectives (For all descriptions)


Identify the patient expectations most strongly linked to retention and treatment acceptance in 2027, including clear communication, provider continuity, and upfront cost transparency.


Evaluate which administrative and clinical workflows are best suited to AI and automation, and which require human judgment, oversight, and patient connection.


Develop a practice improvement plan that pairs operational discipline (clinical consistency, collections, and team role clarity) with a differentiated, personal patient experience.
